story.title: Have You Ever Seen a Bear Fly Above the Clouds?
story.signature_move: It plunges silently from the stratosphere at ninety miles per hour, slamming the cloud ibex with massive, razor-sharp paws.
story.hybrid_look: A terrifying apex predator with a massive, muscular polar bear body covered in dense white fur, glowing ice-blue compound eyes, battle scars, and four shimmering, iridescent dragonfly wings sprouting from its shoulders.

sentences.text: What nightmare roams the highest mountain peaks above the clouds?
sentences.image: jagged, snow-covered mountain peaks piercing through a endless sea of thick white clouds

sentences.text: Meet the Frostwing Ursa, blending a polar bear's terrifying strength with a dragonfly's aerodynamics.
sentences.image: steep cliff edges battered by freezing winds under a pale winter sky

sentences.text: Thick fog blankets the rocky slopes, yet its multifaceted eyes detect movement instantly.
sentences.image: dense, blinding fog rolling rapidly across dangerous, slippery mountain ledges

sentences.text: Frigid high-altitude gales threaten to freeze ordinary beasts solid instantly.
sentences.image: blinding snowstorm howling violently across a steep, icy mountain precipice

sentences.text: Its dense, hollow-hair coat traps body heat just like a real polar bear.
sentences.image: frozen icicles hanging from sheer rock faces illuminated by pale sunlight

sentences.text: It plunges silently from the stratosphere at ninety miles per hour, slamming the cloud ibex with massive, razor-sharp paws.
sentences.image: glowing twilight sky above a vast ocean of fluffy white clouds below

sentences.text: Thin mountain air makes sustained hovering nearly impossible for its huge frame.
sentences.image: vast open sky stretching endlessly above extreme, jagged mountain altitudes

sentences.text: Even apex predators have flaws, but would you try petting one in the comments?
sentences.image: deep, dark shadows stretching across freezing, snow-swept mountain valleys
